title: Practice 4: в- and вы-: in, and out

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: The economy has entered a recession.
exercises.why: **вошла** — past tense (feminine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Let's not get into that.
exercises.why: **влезать** — infinitive, imperfective (perfective partner: влезть).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: I don't fit in these jeans anymore.
exercises.why: **влезаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of влезать: imperfective (perfective partner: влезть).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.ru: Я в эти джинсы уже не ___.

exercises.q: She tiptoed into the house.
exercises.why: **вошла** — past tense (feminine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Is the water included in the rent?
exercises.why: **входит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Japanese forces marched into Burma.
exercises.why: **вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Philip wants to get ripped.
exercises.why: **выйти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I'll never be another Sherlock Holmes.
exercises.why: **выйдет** — future tense (3rd person singular) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Batteries are not included.
exercises.why: **входят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: You'll never be another Sherlock Holmes.
exercises.why: **выйдет** — future tense (3rd person singular) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Enter our humble abode.
exercises.why: **входите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Tom's company imports tea from India.
exercises.why: **ввозит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ввозить: imperfective (perfective partner: ввезти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Inflation is getting out of control.
exercises.why: **выходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of выходить: imperfective (perfective partner: выйти).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: A three-handed monster came out of the wardrobe.
exercises.why: **вылезло** — past tense (neuter) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The bees are zooming out of the hive.
exercises.why: **вылетают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вылетать: imperfective (perfective partner: вылететь).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom's company imports coffee from Brazil.
exercises.why: **ввозит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ввозить: imperfective (perfective partner: ввезти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Moses led the Israelites out of Egypt.
exercises.why: **вывел** — past tense (masculine) of вывести: perfective (imperfective partner: выводить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: That's not part of the original plan.
exercises.why: **входило** — past tense (neuter) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The golf ball almost went in the hole.
exercises.why: **вошел** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.ru: Мяч для гольфа почти ___ в лунку.

exercises.q: She blandished him out of his black mood.
exercises.why: **вывела** — past tense (feminine) of вывести: perfective (imperfective partner: выводить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
